decks.notes: This Dimir Control deck focuses on using mill effects and disruptive spells to control the board and disrupt the opponent's game plan. By utilizing cards like Ruin Crab, Drown in the Loch, and Into the Story, the deck aims to mill the opponent's deck while countering or removing their threats. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion allows for additional recursion of key cards. The deck also includes disruptive spells like Mystical Dispute and Crippling Fear to further control the game and protect its win condition of milling the opponent.

This deck focuses on quickly developing a board presence with efficient creatures, generating card advantage with cards like Edgewall Innkeeper and Magda, Brazen Outlaw, and overwhelming opponents with powerful combat tricks like Embercleave and Shatterskull Smashing. By applying constant pressure on the opponent and utilizing the mana ramp from Goldspan Dragon, this deck aims to close out the game before the opponent can stabilize or mount a defense. The deck's mana base is designed to provide consistent access to both red and green mana sources for casting its spells.

The main focus of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful removal spells. The deck aims to quickly build up a strong board presence and deal damage efficiently to the opponent. The inclusion of cards like Torbran, Thane of Red Fell and Embercleave amplifies the damage output of the creatures, while removal spells like Frost Bite and Bonecrusher Giant help control the opponent's board. The deck also includes cards like Robber of the Rich for card advantage and Faceless Haven for additional threats on the battlefield.

The key concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with a swarm of small, efficient creatures that can quickly build a significant board presence. This is achieved by utilizing low-cost creatures like Selfless Savior and Luminarch Aspirant, supported by powerful cards like Skyclave Apparition and Elite Spellbinder to disrupt the opponent's plans. The inclusion of powerful equipment like Shadowspear and Maul of the Skyclaves enhances the deck's aggression, while the utility lands like Faceless Haven provide additional flexibility and resilience in combat. The deck aims to maintain pressure and control the game tempo to secure a swift victory.

The deck focuses on controlling the board with removal spells and counterspells while ramping up mana to cast powerful spells and ultimatums. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as a companion to provide additional value. The deck includes a mix of creature threats and card advantage spells to outvalue opponents in a long game. The mana base is strategically designed to provide all necessary colors for the spells in the deck. Ultimately, the key strategy is to control the game and overwhelm opponents with powerful late-game plays.

This deck focuses on quickly generating a wide board presence and utilizing Winota's ability to cheat powerful creatures into play to overwhelm the opponent. By utilizing cards like Elite Spellbinder to disrupt the opponent's game plan and Esika's Chariot to generate additional tokens, the deck aims to apply pressure early and often to secure a victory. With a mix of aggressive creatures and powerful support cards, this deck looks to capitalize on Winota's ability to swing the game in its favor with explosive turns and overwhelming board presence.

This deck focuses on quickly putting creatures onto the battlefield to take advantage of Winota's ability to cheat more creatures into play. By using mana acceleration from cards like Lotus Cobra and Prosperous Innkeeper, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with a horde of powerful creatures like Blade Historian and Kenrith, the Returned King. By including cards like Elite Spellbinder and Selfless Savior, the deck also has ways to disrupt opponents' strategies and protect its own key creatures. The goal is to attack aggressively and finish the game before the opponent can stabilize.

The main idea of this deck is to swarm the board with creatures and take advantage of Winota's ability to cheat high-impact creatures into play. By playing creatures like Jaspera Sentinel, Lotus Cobra, and Selfless Savior, the deck aims to trigger Winota's ability consistently, allowing it to quickly overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures like Blade Historian and Kenrith, the Returned King. With additional support from cards like Esika's Chariot and Elite Spellbinder, the deck can quickly snowball and close out the game with a powerful aggro strategy.

The deck focuses on controlling the board through removal spells and counterspells while generating card advantage with cards like Treacherous Blessing and Omen of the Sea. It also uses enchantments like Doom Foretold and Binding the Old Gods to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Yorion, Sky Nomad serves as both a companion and a way to generate value by blinking permanents. The mana base is designed to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells of all colors. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast the opponent to secure victory.

This deck focuses on control through milling opponents with Ruin Crab and disrupting their strategy with counterspells and removal spells like Drown in the Loch and Heartless Act. By utilizing cards like Soaring Thought-Thief and Thieves' Guild Enforcer, the deck aims to quickly fill the opponent's graveyard and take advantage of it with cards like Into the Story and Agadeem's Awakening. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion adds a recurring threat to the strategy, making it difficult for opponents to keep up with the constant disruption and card advantage.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by milling the opponent's library with cards like Ruin Crab and Soaring Thought-Thief, while also disrupting their strategy with counterspells and removal spells. The synergy between cheap creatures and powerful spells allows the player to maintain board presence while maintaining control over the game. The inclusion of Lurrus of the Dream-Den as a companion provides additional value by allowing the player to recur key creatures from the graveyard. The deck aims to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent in a long game of attrition.

The main focus of this deck is to put pressure on the opponent and win the game quickly by utilizing the aggressive creatures and powerful enchantments available in the Gruul colors. The deck aims to ramp up mana quickly using cards like Magda, Brazen Outlaw and Goldspan Dragon, while also providing combat tricks and additional threats with cards like Embercleave and Esika's Chariot. The deck also benefits from the synergy between creatures like Lovestruck Beast and Edgewall Innkeeper, providing card advantage while maintaining a strong board presence.

The main concept of this Jeskai Combo deck is to utilize the powerful abilities of cards like Vadrok, Apex of Thunder and Lore Drakkis to recur spells from the graveyard and generate extra value. Goldspan Dragon provides additional card advantage and mana acceleration, while control elements like Disdainful Stroke and Negate help protect the combo pieces. The deck also includes removal spells like Cinderclasm and Fire Prophecy to handle opposing threats. Overall, the deck aims to set up a powerful combo sequence while controlling the game and maintaining a solid board presence.

The deck focuses on controlling the game by using a combination of removal spells, counterspells, and sweepers to disrupt the opponent's strategy. The deck also ramps up its mana with cards like Cultivate and Wolfwillow Haven to be able to cast powerful late-game threats like Emergent Ultimatum and Elder Gargaroth. Yorion, Sky Nomad acts as a companion to provide additional value by blinking permanents for extra card advantage. Overall, the deck aims to outvalue the opponent and grind out a win through efficient resource management and powerful card advantage.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through removal, counterspells, and disruption while also generating card advantage with Yorion, Sky Nomad. By utilizing powerful threats like Valki, God of Lies and Elder Gargaroth, along with ramp spells like Cultivate, the deck aims to outvalue its opponent and take over the game in the late stages. The inclusion of Emergent Ultimatum allows for powerful combo plays to further solidify its control over the game. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color requirements while providing flexibility and consistency.

This deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with aggressive creatures and powerful spells in the Temur color combination. It aims to control the board with removal spells like Fire Prophecy and Bonecrusher Giant while ramping into big threats like Koma, Cosmos Serpent and Lovestruck Beast. The deck also includes Lukka, Coppercoat Outcast to cheat out big threats and generate additional value. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal, and card advantage engines, this deck aims to establish early dominance and close out the game quickly.
